text_block_list.text:
On our way back from shopping with Marvelous Sunday,
she suddenly sprinted off.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I sense Marvelous coming from over there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh~! A prize raffle!
Marvelous☆★ Dreams are spinning, round and round☆
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll do it, I'll do it!

I take the raffle ticket I received while shopping earlier
out of my pocket.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"...One ticket? But if I pull one,
won't there be none left for you, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Sure, I'm not really lucky with raffles anyway
Sure, I'm not really lucky with raffles anyway

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If you give up right from the start,
you'll never find the Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelousness is something you attract☆
That's why my results are always marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The excitement before you draw is Marvelous☆★
Whatever the result, it's MAAARVELOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: If you're worried, let's pull it together, Trainer!
choice_data_list: ...In that case, maybe I'll give it a pull.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ Marvelous★
Welcome, maaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

Together with Marvelous Sunday,
I enthusiastically spun the raffle machine handle!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!

I was so shocked by the grand prize that
I ended up shouting "Marvelous!" before she did...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip, Trainer!
When should we go?
choice_data_list: Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Really? Marvelous waits for no one☆
It's much more marvelous to enjoy it while it's fresh!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, which hot spring is it?
Let me see...—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ......Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I see, I see!
This must be "fate"!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everything comes full circle and connects back to Marvelous!
Whether it turns into an extraordinary brilliance is entirely up to me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer, looks like now's not the time for the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Even if you go now, all that awaits you is a jewel caked in dirt. An unmistakable jewel, yes, but an unpolished, unsparkling gem.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Once you're ready to polish it into a marvelous gem,
let's go together☆

I couldn't quite grasp what Marvelous Sunday was telling me.
However, she seemed to hold an unwavering resolve.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You hold onto the travel vouchers, Trainer.
I feel like I'd lose them if I kept 'em.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—When that time comes,
I'll definitely come invite you!

"She didn't say how long it would be until then.
Still, I had a feeling the chance to use it would come before long."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay~!
Carrot Hamburg Steak time☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The towering carrot is super marvelous☆
Seeing an upright carrot gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone loves it! I love it too!
Carrot hamburg steak is the marvelous taste☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The fluffy burger patty bursts with juicy goodness~~☆
It mingles with the demi-glace sauce, wrapping around the meat★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hop, step, one jump to the rice☆ Eat your meat, and get that demi-glace gravy on rice★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Then crunch, crunch, crunch on some carrots☆
Yummy × yummy! A marvelous mouth of pure bliss★☆"

Marvelous Sunday's pitch for the marvelousness of Salisbury steaks
was far more convincing than expected.
Now my mouth is totally craving Salisbury steak...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go home and eat together!
Carrot Salisbury steak☆

We hurried back to the academy, where Marvelous Sunday
and I thoroughly enjoyed an extra-special marvelous feast.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh, so many carrots!
choice_data_list: Looks like we have enough to share.
Looks like we can share some with others.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, that's a marvelous idea☆
I'll eat it together with everyone in the dorms!
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone will be pleased.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Thank you!
I'll bring some to Trainer later too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Is it really alright
for me to take this many carrots?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I figured we could all eat together!
So Creek, I want you to give it
a marvelous makeover☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, leave it to me. How about kinpira, some simmered stew, seasoned rice, or squid-and-carrot salad?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Curry, stew, and pot-au-feu sound great too!
And of course, carrot hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do you feel like eating, Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Me? Um... sweets, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Carrot cake, carrot cookies,
carrot bavarois... *drool*."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Thanks to everyone,
there are so many marvelous dishes~☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely marvelous!
But first—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's make a toast with this!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheers to marvelousness~☆

And then, I too received a share of
"marvelous" from Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh~~! What a splendid carrot!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A deep, vivid orange color!
With smooth skin, and a petite top like a small face☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A super, duper fresh carrot!
Marveeeelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because it's fresh right now! It'd be such a waste
if the Marvelous faded away with time!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Owner
text_block_list.text: "That's right! Man, you really get it! Vegetables taste way better when you eat 'em fresh!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right? ☆ With fresh carrots,
you can savor their natural marvelousness as-is! ★

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Here, lemme cut it in half for ya.
You two should enjoy this fresh carrot together.
'Cause it's gonna be absolutely Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Thank you, mister produce guy!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the Marvelouuus☆★☆

And so, savoring the fresh carrots—
Marvelous's cheerful voice echoed
through the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Tissues~! ☆★☆
choice_data_list: Sorry... It's because I pulled along with you.
Sorry... It's because I pulled along with you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why? It's totally marvelous!☆
You can never have too many handy pocket tissues, they're always a treat!★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Besides... a-achoo!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Achoo! *sniff* Achoo!
choice_data_list: Are you okay!? Here, use this!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, the tissues came in handy, didn't they?
choice_data_list: Still, I used it all up... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
............
...Don't apologize, Trainer.
âIt ended up being a bittersweet result...
